message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае штраф за переход дороги в неположенном месте составит 400 дирхам","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"Полиция Дубая предупреждает пешеходов о штрафе в размере 400 дирхам за нарушение правил перехода дорог по статье 89 Федерального закона о дорожном движении","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Нарушение включает переход на красный свет или в непредназначенных местах","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Бригадир Маджид Султан Аль Суваиди призвал использовать только обозначенные переходы и соблюдать сигналы светофора","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"Власти запустили кампанию по повышению безопасности пешеходов","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Власти призывают водителей снижать скорость и уступать дорогу","supported":true,"evidence":[7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the Russian post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Embassy of Pakistan in Abu Dhabi and the Consulate General of Pakistan in Dubai started processing e-Passport applications from October 23, 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"All new passport applications are accepted only as e-Passports.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Pakistani nationals with valid Machine Readable Passports can continue to use them until expiry.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"Applicants are advised to apply for renewal only if their passport validity is less than six months.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"The cost of a standard renewal starts at 145 dirhams for a 36-page passport valid for 5 years.","supported":true,"evidence":[12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"Ras Al Khaimah closed all its beaches until further notice.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The reason for the closure was not disclosed.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Authorities urge the public to comply with guidelines for safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Similar measures were taken in other emirates: Al Hamriya Beach in Sharjah was temporarily closed due to an oil slick.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6]},{"claim":"Beaches in Umm Al Quwain were closed after an oil spill.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]},{"claim":"The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment confirmed that the fuel-like smell poses no health risk.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,9]},{"claim":"Cleanup and containment work is underway to address the pollution.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"In Khor Fakkan, boats are being relocated from three berths.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The Khor Fakkan Municipality announced the evacuation of boats from the first three berths on the boat landing side of Khor Fakkan Marina.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Boat owners must move their boats to Al Lulu'iyah Marina by October 28.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"After October 28, the municipality will take measures against those who do not comply.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The second edition of the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial is taking place.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The second edition opened in Al Ain.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The Biennial is organized by the Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The exhibition is under the theme 'Home: A Glossary for a Communal Sense of Place'.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The exhibition in Al Ain will last until 15 February 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,19]},{"claim":"Four new works are presented in Al Ain.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The works are located in Al Qattara Oasis and Al Towayya Roundabout.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,9]},{"claim":"Artists from different countries reinterpret traditional and natural elements of the region through contemporary art.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,7,8,9]},{"claim":"The Biennial will continue in Abu Dhabi from 15 November 2026 with new projects and a public program.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,17,19]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"A rare Batman comic is on display in Sharjah for 60,000 dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"At the Sharjah Animation and Comics Conference (SACC), a collector's edition comic Batman: The Killing Joke Avant-Garde Edition weighing 4.4 kg with a detachable lens is presented.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The price of the comic is 60,000 dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Only 47 copies of the comic have been produced.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,12]},{"claim":"The comic is designed like a camera with aluminum boards lined with goatskin and kept in a leather case.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,5,6]},{"claim":"The edition was created by Croatian publisher Argent Comics.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]},{"claim":"It is considered the world's first comic printed using the giclée method.","supported":true,"evidence":[8]},{"claim":"The SACC conference is held at Aljada and will continue until Sunday.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,23]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The winners of the Arab Reading Challenge will be announced on October 29.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The closing ceremony will be held at the Dubai World Trade Centre on October 29.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"More than 40 million students from 60 countries are participating in the competition.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,9]},{"claim":"The competition includes 74 thousand participants in the People of Determination category.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The total prize fund is 11 million dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"The main prize is 500 thousand dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"The best school will receive one million dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"The organizer is the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum initiative.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,9]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"On October 25, 2026, RTA will open the final bridge of the World Trade Centre Roundabout Development Project in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The final bridge is 1000 meters long.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The bridge will improve traffic flow from Al Majlis Street to 2nd December Street.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The bridge accommodates approximately 3000 vehicles per hour.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The bridge will reduce journey time from six minutes to one minute on the route from Al Majlis Street to 2nd December Street.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The project cost exceeds 696 million dirhams.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The project includes five bridges with a combined length of 5000 meters.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The project will reduce average delay at the intersection from 12 minutes to 90 seconds.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The project will benefit more than 500,000 residents and visitors.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Municipality awarded contracts worth AED 3 billion for four projects under Phase 3 of the Tasreef Programme to develop the stormwater drainage system.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2]},{"claim":"The total length of new stormwater drainage lines will be approximately 100 km with diameters up to 3 meters.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The projects cover key areas including Jumeirah, Al Quoz, Al Barsha, and others.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The projects will increase the capacity and resilience of the stormwater drainage system.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4]},{"claim":"The Tasreef Programme aims to prepare the city for climate change and supports the UAE's Net Zero 2050 Strategy.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"From January 1, 2027, new practical driving test rules will take effect in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,20]},{"claim":"To pass the test, a minimum score of 75% is required.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Dangerous mistakes can lead to automatic failure even if the overall score is high.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3,8]},{"claim":"Examples of dangerous mistakes include losing control of the car, hitting a kerb, ignoring traffic signs, and dangerous gear changes.","supported":true,"evidence":[9]},{"claim":"If the examiner intervenes to prevent an accident, the candidate can fail automatically.","supported":true,"evidence":[10]},{"claim":"The rules apply to all candidates taking tests from January 1, 2027, regardless of when they started training.","supported":true,"evidence":[19,20]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The UAE launched an upgraded Wage Protection System (WPS) that enables employers to manage salary payments digitally without paperwork or visiting banks.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The system was developed with the participation of the Central Bank of the UAE and Al Etihad Payments.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The upgraded system enables real-time data exchange and is connected to 17 financial institutions including major banks and exchange centers.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The WPS covers more than 99% of private-sector workers with average monthly wage transfers of about AED 37 billion.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The upgraded platform accelerates salary processing, increases transparency, and supports financial inclusion aligned with the We the UAE 2031 strategy.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3] }]}
